Suggested use: Mix 1 serving (1 Scoop) of FINAFLEX CREATINE with 4-8 fl oz of water or your favorite flavored beverage.
Loading Phase: Take 2 servings, twice daily for the first 3 days. Take 2 servings in the morning & 2 servings at night.
Maintenance phase: Take 1 Serving (1 Scoop) of FINAFLEX CREATINE 2 times daily.

Warning: Keep out of reach of children.
Intended for healthy adults over 18.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Do not use if pregnant or nursing. Consult a doctor or medical authority before use if you have a medical condition, a family history of health issues, or if you take medicines or supplements.
Do not exceed serving size. Stop use if you have a bad reaction. Stop after 8 weeks. Stop 2 weeks before surgery. Consumer accepts all liability if used inconsistent with label.
Sold by weight, not volume. Store under cool, dry conditions, ideally 50-80 degrees F. Do not discard desiccant.
